item.title: BareMetal RAM Dumper – Bare-metal x86 tool for Cold Boot Attack experiments
item.description:
📝 Direct Disk Write: Uses BIOS INT 0x13 AH=0x43 (Extended Write) to write the memory contents directly back to the boot drive starting at LBA 64. Warning ⚠️ This tool writes raw data directly to the boot drive starting at Sector 64. bin of=/dev/sdX bs=512 Boot your target PC from the USB drive (ensure Legacy BIOS / CSM boot is enabled).
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/pIat0n/BareMetal-RAM-Dumper

item.title: Plein Air
item.description:
📝 Plein air — French for in the open air — was the discipline of painting outdoors, in front of the weather, the way Constable studied clouds in Suffolk meadows and Monet painted the same haystacks at every hour of every season. The sky over your head and the sky in the painting share the same kind of hour — the same long afternoon, the same threatening storm, the same fog clinging to the river. Every painting shown is in the public domain.
🔗 Read more: https://art.joonas.wtf/
